repository-integration.title: Integrate tested candidate
repository-integration.intro: Review an accepted, independently tested candidate and explicitly advance a managed target branch. This supports fast-forward integration; it does not change the current IDE workspace.
repository-integration.source_hint: Only the server's current accepted source and independent test evidence can be used.
repository-integration.no_sources: No eligible accepted candidate is available. Complete the independent tests and task acceptance first.
repository-integration.no_targets: No target has been bound to this project. A project approver can bind an administrator-configured target below.
repository-integration.target_busy: This target has an unresolved operation. Inspect its original plan before preparing another integration.
repository-integration.prepare_help: Preparation runs on an authorized Runner and reads the real target diff. It does not update the target branch or approve integration.
repository-integration.target_binding_he: Choose an administrator-configured provider and alias. Its branch and configuration are read from the provider; local paths and credentials are never entered here.
repository-integration.no_providers: An administrator must configure a repository integration provider and target aliases first. Arbitrary URLs or repository paths cannot be entered here.
repository-integration.preparing_help: The Runner is preparing the fixed target and candidate. The review appears after the provider returns its actual diff.
repository-integration.ff_help: The result is exactly this tested candidate. A diverged target requires a newly developed and tested candidate; approval cannot override this restriction.
repository-integration.preview_blocked: This preview cannot be approved. The diff must be complete, reviewable and eligible for fast-forward integration.
repository-integration.empty_diff: The provider returned an empty diff.
repository-integration.applying_help: The authorized integration run is applying the original operation. Integration is confirmed only by its validated Git receipt.
repository-integration.unknown_help: The outcome is unknown. Keep this target reserved and reconcile the original operation. Do not start another integration or choose an outcome manually.
repository-integration.blocked_help: Resolve the reported conflict or source change, then explicitly prepare a new plan. Previous approval cannot authorize a changed candidate or target.
repository-integration.integrated_bounda: The receipt proves this operation advanced the configured target. Deployment, release publication and later branch changes are separate facts.
repository-integration.reason_hint: Briefly record the review, execution or reconciliation basis.
repository-integration.approve_ack: I reviewed this exact diff, tested result and target, and approve this fixed integration plan.
repository-integration.execute_ack: I explicitly authorize applying this approved result to the fixed target using a compare-and-swap update.
repository-integration.reconcile_ack: I authorize checking and, where necessary, fencing the original operation. The provider's evidence determines the outcome.
repository-integration.no_history: No integration plans have been prepared for this task.
repository-integration.recovery_help: The response was not confirmed. Restore this exact request and operation key; do not create a replacement operation.
repository-integration.invalid_read: The integration response does not match this project's fixed task and evidence contract.
repository-integration.refresh_failed: Current integration facts could not be read. Your reason and target settings have been kept.
repository-integration.access_changed: Current access to this integration has changed. Refresh using the authorized account.
repository-integration.reason.changed: The plan version changed. Read the original plan again before deciding.
repository-integration.reason.basis: The accepted task, review, tests or sealed candidate changed. Prepare a new plan.
repository-integration.reason.target: The target binding or observed Git state changed. Prepare a new plan using current facts.
repository-integration.reason.busy: The target has an unresolved operation. Reconcile that original operation first.
repository-integration.reason.approval: Current browser approval of this exact prepared diff is required.
repository-integration.reason.provider: The configured integration provider is unavailable or missing.
repository-integration.reason.unknown: The repository effect is unknown. Inspect and reconcile the original operation.
repository-integration.reason.observatio: The provider evidence does not match the fixed operation. Integration remains unconfirmed.
repository-integration.reason.expired: The plan or its authorization expired. Refresh the original plan before continuing.
